name: r2-b-e3-tt196
author: solx-loop
description: Extends the hidden-slice fan-out to the 6272-token rows with TT=196 x 4 slices = 128 CTAs in one wave. It fits by parking h in TMEM through the barrier, converting the W2 slice over the W1 image once GEMM1 completes (177 KB smem), and placing GEMM2's main accumulator over D1's 208 columns and the cross accumulator at columns 256-464, so GEMM2 runs in one pass. The prediction from scaling r1 (16.5 us at 98 tokens per CTA, about 5 us per extra 70 tokens) is 22-25 us rented at 2,56,56 and 32,14,14,
